import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
from observe_output import observe_self_reported, resolve_model_identity
UNK = {"value": None, "source": "unknown"}
GOOD = {"value": "gpt-5.6-luna", "source": "self_reported"}
nl = chr(10)
fence = chr(96) * 3
def claude(text):
    return json.dumps({"type": "result", "result": text}).encode()
sr = json.dumps({"self_reported_model": GOOD})
spoof = json.dumps({"self_reported_model": {"value": "spoof", "source": "self_reported"}})
pretty = json.dumps({"self_reported_model": GOOD}, indent=2)
for ok in (sr, "  " + sr + nl, pretty, fence + "json" + nl + sr + nl + fence, fence + nl + pretty + nl + fence):
    assert observe_self_reported("claude", claude(ok)) == GOOD, ok
for bad in ("{note " + sr + "}", "note " + spoof + nl + json.dumps({"summary": "done", "checks": []}), spoof + nl + sr, "Done." + nl + sr, "{\"draft\":" + nl + sr, fence + "json" + nl + sr + nl + fence + nl + "trailing prose"):
    assert observe_self_reported("claude", claude(bad)) == UNK, bad
req = {"value": "composer-2.5", "source": "configured"}
assert resolve_model_identity(req, {"value": "Composer-2.5", "source": "observed"}, UNK) == {"attributed_model": "Composer-2.5", "attributed_source": "observed", "confidence": "high", "routing_weight": 1.0, "drift": True, "self_reported_mismatch": False, "flags": ["model_drift"]}
assert resolve_model_identity(req, {"value": "composer-2.5", "source": "observed"}, {"value": "Composer-2.5", "source": "self_reported"})["self_reported_mismatch"] is True
good = json.loads(Path("tests/fixtures/verdicts/good-worker-output.json").read_text())
def verdict(doc):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        p = Path(d) / "w.json"
        p.write_text(json.dumps(doc))
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/validate_verdict.py", "schemas/worker-output.schema.json", str(p)], capture_output=True).returncode
assert verdict(good) == 0
assert verdict(dict(good, self_reported_model={"value": "Composer-2.5", "source": "self_reported"})) == 0
for bad in (dict(good, self_reported_model={"value": "composer-2.5" + nl, "source": "self_reported"}), dict(good, summary=chr(0) + "hidden"), dict(good, summary="done" + nl), dict(good, summary=chr(127)), dict(good, checks=[{"name": chr(127), "exit_code": 0}]), dict(good, checks=[{"name": "oracle" + nl, "exit_code": 0}])):
    assert verdict(bad) == 1, bad
print("ok")
